_comment: Data-source manifest for reproducibility. One entry per downloadable source:
url = the download URL, filename = the cache basename download_and_cache writes,
sha256 = expected digest of the raw file. The sha256 slots are null because the
hashes cannot be computed without downloading the (large, government) files, and
several publishers re-issue the same logical file at rotating media URLs each year.
Fill a sha256 in after a verified download and src/urban_energy/fetch.download_and_cache
will verify every subsequent cached copy against it. Templated / multi-file sources
(census topic-summary zips, per-LA FSA XML) have no single filename and are recorded
with a url_template and a null filename.

desnz_electricity_postcode.note: DESNZ postcode-level domestic electricity, 2024 (media id rotates yearly).

imd_2025_file7.note: MHCLG English Indices of Deprivation 2025, File 7 (LSOA21).

dvla_veh0125.note: DfT/DVLA all vehicles by body type/keepership/status, LSOA.

dvla_veh0135.note: DfT/DVLA ultra-low-emission vehicles by fuel type, LSOA.

nts9904_mileage.note: DfT National Travel Survey NTS9904 car miles/person by 2021 RUC.

ons_ruc21_oa.note: ONS 2021 Rural-Urban Classification of Output Areas (EW).

census_topic_summaries.note: Census 2021 topic-summary zips (TS001, TS006, TS011, TS017, TS044, TS045, TS054, TS058, TS061, TS062). Cached as ts{ts}_oa.parquet after extraction, not the raw zip.

census_workplace_wp101ew.note: NOMIS WP101EW workplace population per OA (paged, 25k rows/page).

gias_establishments.note: DfE Get Information About Schools daily bulk CSV (date-stamped URL).

fsa_establishments.note: FSA Food Hygiene Ratings, one XML per England local authority (~350 files).

nhs_ods.note: NHS ODS ets/epraccur/edispensary. Legacy bulk zips retired Oct 2025; export from the ODS Data Search & Export portal. Cached as {name}.csv after zip extraction.
